title: Yarchei Kallah in Yerushalayim
body: Join a week of intense Torah learning in Yerushalayim from Feb 15-19, 2026, led by gedolei Yisroel and maggidei shiur.

title: Stabbing in Crown Heights
body: A Jewish man was stabbed in Crown Heights, sparking a manhunt for the suspect. The attack occurred around 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday near Lincoln Place, amid growing concerns over antisemitic attacks in the neighborhood. NYPD pledged increased security.
